subject: License renewal window and handoff planning — GH/JB/ATL
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: License renewal window and handoff planning — GH/JB/ATL

Team,

Quick note to flag the upcoming renewal windows across our core developer tooling: GitHub Enterprise (Dec 2026), JetBrains All Products (Jan 2027), Atlassian (Mar 2027).

We discussed consolidation at the leadership offsite; procurement wants a concrete plan by end of month so we can lock pricing and avoid seat creep. My proposal:
- Consolidate GitHub and JetBrains renewals into a single negotiation block (target: Dec 10–20 for GitHub quote and Jan 7–14 for JetBrains final sign).
- Stagger Atlassian later to align with engineering team migrations (Mar renew).
- Owners: Marcus (GitHub + JetBrains negotiation lead), Lauren (cost modeling + finance sync), Grace (migration cadence + licenses decomm).

I attached the inventory sheet I pulled from the license DB — gives seat counts and last activity. Please review and flag any obvious mismatches.

Attachments: renewal-inventory-2026.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Hale <sara.hale@github.com>, Benjamin Kovacs <benjamin.kovacs@jetbrains.com>, Atlassian Renewals <atlassian-renewals@atlassian.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:35:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: License renewal window and handoff planning — GH/JB/ATL

Folks — looping you in so we can get consolidated quotes and options.

Action items for vendors:
- Provide firm renewal quotes tied to current seat counts in the attached inventory (see attached consolidation-ask.docx).
- For GitHub: include enterprise + any high-availability / SSO add-ons; note any volume discounts for multi-year commit.
- For JetBrains: we are evaluating a mixed floating/per-seat approach; please outline migration support pricing.
- For Atlassian: high-level timelines only for now — we plan to stagger that renewal.

Please send initial quotes or clarify gaps by Tue, Nov 30. If there are questions on counts, reach out to Grace for usage signals.

Attachments: consolidation-ask.docx (doc)

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Infrastructure Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Hale <sara.hale@github.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Benjamin Kovacs <benjamin.kovacs@jetbrains.com>, Atlassian Renewals <atlassian-renewals@atlassian.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: License renewal window and handoff planning — GH/JB/ATL

Marcus / team —

Thanks for the heads up and the inventory. Quick answers from GitHub side:
- We can provide a consolidated enterprise renewal with a 10–14% volume tier for a 2-year commit.
- HA/SSO add-ons are priced separately; I'll attach a short PDF with options and example TCO that maps to your counts.
- If you want a single negotiation for both GitHub and JetBrains, we can coordinate timing but contracts remain independent.

Link to preliminary quote and contract starter (DocuSign): https://docusign.net/XYZ-Doc-12345
Attachment: ghe-pricing-options.pdf

On counts: I noticed a handful of inactive seats flagged in your inventory. If you can confirm seat reclaims by Nov 30, we can reflect that in the quote (saves you ~$8–12k annually).

Happy to hop on a 30-min call if that helps.

Best,
Sara Hale
Strategic Accounts, GitHub Enterprise

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Hale <sara.hale@github.com>, Benjamin Kovacs <benjamin_kovacs@jetbrains.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: License renewal window and handoff planning — GH/JB/ATL

Thanks Sara — useful context. A few quick asks from finance/procurement side:

1) Can we get a line-item breakdown (by seat type/SSO/HA) and an example year-over-year TCO for 1-year vs 2-year commit?
2) We're especially interested in a short "canary" plan: buy a smaller block at renewal price for 2 teams (approx 150 seats) to validate any integration changes before full roll. Please indicate whether that is supported and any penalties for early scale.

This is for deal DL-8421; procurement will prefer bundled discounts if we can commit across vendors, but we also need individual contract terms to stay clean for legal review.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: License renewal window and handoff planning — GH/JB/ATL — plan and next steps

All — quick summary and next steps so we have a single source of truth:

Summary decisions:
- Move ahead to negotiate GitHub Enterprise renewal first and request the 2-year volume tier. Target: finalize quote from GitHub by Dec 15; procurement/finance review Dec 16–20.
- Parallel ask to JetBrains for mixed floating/per-seat pricing; aim to finalize by Jan 14.
- Defer Atlassian to March window with a separate migration plan.

Owners & deadlines:
- Marcus: lead vendor negotiation (GitHub + JetBrains) — draft term sheet by Dec 8.
- Lauren: produce TCO comparison and approve canary plan (due Dec 3).
- Grace: confirm seat reclaim list and sign off on counts (due Nov 30).
- Vivek: executive escalation path and approval gate (if discounts require exec signoff).

Vendor asks outstanding:
- GitHub (Sara) — line item TCO and DocuSign starter (Sara provided preliminary link).
- JetBrains (Benjamin) — provide floating-seat migration cost and any migration support credits.
- Atlassian — high-level timelines only for now.

Attachments referenced: renewal-inventory-2026.xlsx, consolidation-ask.docx, ghe-pricing-options.pdf
Related links: https://docusign.net/XYZ-Doc-12345, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/renewal-playbook-2026

If no objections, I'll kick off the first negotiation loop on Monday and schedule a 30-min sync with procurement.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Infrastructure Platform
Redwood Inference
